ARCHIVED NOTICE

Master’s admissions notice

Published: 2022-11-06

Back to news

This is an archived 2022 notice and does not establish current admissions requirements. Contact the lab for current information.

Master’s admissions notice

Recommended applicants

The historical notice described eligibility for recommended admission, participation in the School of Electronic and Information Engineering summer programme, interest in the laboratory’s research and good English proficiency.

Entrance-examination applicants

The notice described eligibility for admission through the examination, interest in the laboratory’s research and good English proficiency.

Application materials

Applicants were asked to email Professor Hanli Wang a curriculum vitae, their study plans, a certified undergraduate transcript and ranking, copies of language qualifications, and other relevant academic work, awards or qualifications.

The original notice described a résumé review and interview by the laboratory. This is an archived notice; current admissions procedures and decisions must be confirmed with the university and laboratory.

Original Chinese notice

欢迎报考同济大学MIC实验室硕士研究生

一、推免硕士生（部分名额）

具备推免资格，有意向报考MIC实验室的本科生，应需满足以下条件：
1、具有推免资格并参加同济大学电子与信息工程学院暑期学校预推免
2、对实验室相关研究领域有一定了解并具有浓厚兴趣
3、英语水平良好

二、统考硕士生（部分名额）

参加统考、有意向报考MIC实验室的本科生，应需满足以下条件：
1、报名学生认真备考，拿到拟录取资格
2、对实验室相关研究领域有一定了解并具有浓厚兴趣
3、英语水平良好

三、申请流程

满足上述条件的申请者将以下材料：
1、个人简历
2、求学意愿以及预期
3、本科成绩单(由教务处或学院盖章) 与总评成绩排名
4、外语水平证明复印件（如：英语四、六级考试成绩，托福成绩或GRE/GMAT成绩等）
5、其他材料(如:能体现个人学术水平的学术论文、出版物或原创性工作成果，各类获奖或资格证书等)
通过邮件形式发送给王瀚漓教授（ hanliwang@tongji.edu.cn ）

通过实验室的简历评估以及面试考核的申请者，则正式成为MIC实验室录取硕士生。
